req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject non-string titles with an HTTP 422 response. This behavior needs to be validated through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The positive case ensures that valid string titles are accepted, the negative case checks that non-string titles are rejected, and the boundary case tests the edge of string length constraints.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_string_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid string title.
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "A valid task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_non_string_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a non-string title (e.g., integer).
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title must be a string.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": 123, "description": "A task with non-string title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "str type expected"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_string_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty string title.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title must not be empty.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "A task with empty title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "ensure this value has at least 1 characters"
